visualReview.status: 13-view render and hash validation passed; visual-fidelity acceptance remains pending. Roof tone uses a low-confidence aerial-photo estimate and the raised central dome-base platform adds a discrete roof section; texture/UV, fine roof segmentation, side/back framing and surveyed footprint remain unresolved.
findings: Side-by-side comparison with the licensed south/front reference showed the 39 m estimated stair base visually dominating the facade; reduced it to a 27 m (~48% of the provisional 55.8 m frontage) estimate, pending rectification.
The original cumulative stair blocks concealed tread faces; generated one fixed-rise block per tread plus nosing detail, preserving the 16 m run and 6.4 m rise.
Dome mid-body radii were enlarged to remove the visibly conical taper while retaining the 6.53 m body-height budget.
Review lighting was raised and moved closer because the first contact sheet under-lit facade and roof detail.
Wider/taller opening proportions reduce the excessive blank spandrel band; dimensions remain estimates pending rectified elevation.
LOD3 adds small arch keystones/imposts and 16 dome meridian rib lines that follow the current profile samples.
The review light rig was reduced and rebalanced to improve pink tone, window recess contrast, and stair tread definition.

The front review camera uses a five-degree elevation to show stair treads; the dedicated RoofDeck plane is hidden only in this detail render and remains in the GLB/other 12 views. This is render framing, not a geometry-accuracy claim.
Rangmahal-focused front plus 12 whole-model views preserve both facade-detail and full-footprint review coverage.

A hash-pinned unrectified aerial photo shows large flat roof planes with multiple roof sections; a raised central dome-base platform was added using 14.0 m × 12.0 m [E] estimates, while other roof planes remain simplified parametric surfaces.

The first roof-tint estimate #777168 still rendered too pale in the top-view comparison; the roof-deck proxy was darkened to #4A4740 using the same uncalibrated aerial reference. Roof texture/UV and precise section geometry remain unresolved.

The prior focused-front render included an unrelated rear/left wing and clipped the facade edge. P3.3 now hides non-Rangmahal meshes for the front-detail view and fits that camera to the visible projected bounds; the regenerated front.png must be inspected before the framing change is accepted.

The prior back and left/right orthographic views had too much whitespace for useful detail inspection. P3.3 now computes orthographic scale from each camera's projected mesh bounds; the regenerated images must be inspected before the framing change is accepted.

The narrowed portico/stair landing, scaled dome profile, roof tone and roof-plane relationship are compared against four hash-pinned licensed views, including an unrectified aerial image; all dimensions remain estimates pending rectified elevation or independent survey.

The facade remains highly stylized with pale, flat material appearance. Texture QA confirms zero images, zero textures, zero UV accessors, and all 21 primitives untextured; texture/facade fidelity is not verified.
Several oblique views show a visually awkward stepped/elongated massing silhouette; it must be checked against permission-cleared multi-view references and a traced footprint before acceptance.
residualRisks: Historical proportions and all [E]/[C]/[?] parameters require rectified elevations or measured survey.
Geometry QA still reports topology warnings; texture QA reports no embedded texture images/atlas. Publication eligibility remains false.
